locations.square: Under a slate-grey sky, Briarhollow crowds around its silent bell tower. The sound still comes, every midnight, from somewhere beneath the earth.
locations.tavern: Orange firelight moves across the beams of the Lantern & Thistle. Mira has stopped polishing her glass to watch your approach.
locations.market: Yarrow arranges thornroot and silverleaf in shallow wooden trays. The air smells of wet earth, wax, and bitter tea.
locations.well: The old well has no bucket. Runes edge its rim, and fresh tracks lead away from the stonework toward the trees.
locations.forest: Ashwood closes around the path. Among half-buried pillars, something old waits for the intruders who followed the bell.
